description: ai-agent plugin hooks. Safety (PreToolUse): deny git write operations (the developer commits, never the plugin) and deny file writes containing secret-shaped or PHI-shaped values — both fail open without jq, defense-in-depth on top of the agents' prompt-level hard rules. Observability (PostToolUse): append metadata-only events (skill invocations, agent spawns, standards reads, artifact writes, plus the safety hooks' denials) to .claude/ai-agent-metrics/events.jsonl for /agent-audit — never blocks, never logs content. Workspace (SessionStart): idempotently scaffold docs/input-specs/ and docs/output-specs/ in consuming repos (skipped in repos whose .claude/ai-agent.json context pointer says the docs tree lives in a sibling context repo) — never blocks, guarded against unrelated repos.
